notes: recovery_rate is the share of contained element that physically leaves the process as a saleable product.

payable_fraction is the share of the recovered element's market value that the refiner actually PAYS the holder. Refiners quote black mass on 'payables': a typical contract pays 60-70% of contained nickel and cobalt value and much less for lithium. Ignoring payables is the single largest source of over-valuation in naive battery residual-value models.
Effective revenue per kg of contained element = market_price * recovery_rate * payable_fraction.

EU Regulation 2023/1542 Annex XII sets MINIMUM recovery targets: from 31 Dec 2027 Co/Cu/Pb/Ni 90% and Li 50%; from 31 Dec 2031 Co/Cu/Pb/Ni 95% and Li 80%. Rates below those targets are what plants achieve commercially today; they are floors on regulation, not on physics.

hydrometallurgical.label: Mechanical pre-treatment to black mass, then hydrometallurgical refining
hydrometallurgical.description: Today's mainstream commercial route in Europe and China. Recovers nickel, cobalt, manganese and (partially) lithium as battery-grade salts.

pyrometallurgical.label: Smelting (pyrometallurgy) with hydrometallurgical refining of the alloy
pyrometallurgical.description: Robust to mixed and damaged feed and needs no discharge, but lithium, aluminium and graphite are lost to slag or burned as reductant.

direct_recycling.label: Direct cathode-to-cathode recycling
direct_recycling.description: Emerging route that relithiates and reuses the cathode powder instead of dissolving it. Highest theoretical value retention, but needs single-chemistry, well-sorted feed and is not yet at commercial scale.

nimh_stainless_smelting.label: Stainless-steel smelting of nickel metal hydride packs
nimh_stainless_smelting.description: NiMH packs are fed to stainless-steel smelters, where nickel and cobalt report to the alloy. Rare earths in the AB5 anode go to slag and are not paid for.

lead_acid_smelting.label: Secondary lead smelting
lead_acid_smelting.description: A mature closed loop. Lead recovery economics are strong enough that scrap lead-acid batteries carry a positive scrap price almost everywhere.

notes: End-of-life lithium batteries move as UN3480/UN3481 Class 9 dangerous goods. Damaged or defective packs fall under ADR special provision 376, which forces individually approved packaging and pushes freight cost up several-fold.
Rates are indicative European road freight including collection, DG packaging and documentation.
Cost of turning a retired traction pack into a stationary storage product: incoming test, disassembly to module, capacity grading, rebuild, new BMS, enclosure, certification and warranty reserve.
Grading is the dominant line item and scales with module count rather than energy, which is why small packs repurpose poorly.

Direct resale as a replacement traction pack for the same vehicle model. Usually the highest-value pathway when state of health is high and the model still has a vehicle parc, but it needs a clean safety record and a working BMS.
Value is anchored to the OEM replacement pack price, discounted for age, health and the absence of an OEM warranty.
